submitted.rationale: At 2.06 eV illumination BiVO4 (gap ~2.4 eV) should barely absorb, so I focused on low-Bi, Cu-rich Cu-vanadate regions, where the band gaps are about 1.9–2.0 eV. Of the three measurements, idx 14 (Bi0.075 Cu0.67 V0.255) gave the highest photocurrent, 1.3e-7 A. idx 60 (Cu:V ~1:1) was close behind at 1.2e-7 A, which suggests the whole low-Bi Cu-V edge performs similarly. The Bi-bearing mid-composition was clearly worse.

rejected.reason: Measured 4e-8 A; mid-composition with more Bi is worse
